asciichat_error_t options_json_parse_value (const char * name, yyjson_val * value, char * output, size_t output_size, bool * omitted)

Convert and parse a JSON value with the CLI handler, without publishing global options. omitted is set for an explicitly disabled optional flag such as test-pattern=false. Full cross-option validation remains in the normal CLI worker initialization.
